title: coaching-cadence-rapid-1on1-cheatsheet-maya-kaur-mar08-2028
notes:
Context: Quick, timeboxed (20–25m) 1:1 prep for an IC (Sami) approaching a promotion packet and running a high-priority rollout. Goal is to unblock delivery, calibrate career signals, and create 2 concrete actions.

Agenda (20 min):
- 0:00–02:00 quick check-in (mood, bandwidth)
- 02:00–07:00 recent wins & signal review (what looked good, what customers noticed)
- 07:00–13:00 current blockers for rollout (tech / infra / approvals)
- 13:00–18:00 career growth checkpoint (impact areas, mentorship opportunities)
- 18:00–20:00 actions + expectations + scheduling follow-up

Prep notes on the report (Sami):
- Recent wins: landed PRs that reduced tail latency in dedicated pool (PR#412), led cross-team triage for the bug that hit canary on 2028-03-05.
- Signals to highlight for promotion packet: ownership of rollout, measurable latency improvement (p99 down 12%), mentoring two new hires, improved CI gating for model variants.
- Risk areas: documentation gaps for oncall runbook, one unresolved flaky test in regression suite, pending infra quota increase request (INF-782) blocking final capacity test.
- Bandwidth: paired last week, but taking PTO next week (2028-03-15–2028-03-17) — need to shift any critical ship tasks now.

Technical blockers (to resolve in this 1:1):
- Quota increase still in approval: follow-up owner is Sami but needs product infra sponsor. Escalation path: ping Arjun (infra manager) + include INF-782 in today's update.
- Flaky test (integration suite): replicate locally with --stress; potential short-term mitigation: mark as flaky in CI with a note and add a follow-up ticket for root cause.
- Docs/runbook gap: create minimal runbook checklist for oncall handoff (15–30min doc) before PTO.

Career / growth coaching bullets:
- Frame promotion narrative: impact (latency wins + customer-facing stability), scope (cross-team coordination), and apprenticeship (mentoring). Offer to draft the impact bullets and review before the packet deadline (2028-03-22).
- Stretch opportunity: lead postmortem + follow-up improvements for the canary incident; this gives cross-functional visibility and a concrete narrative.
- Mentorship: encourage Sami to run two 1-hour knowledge-sharing sessions in April (topic: continuous batching & KV-cache debugging).

Concrete action items (agreed during meeting):
1) Submit escalation email for INF-782 to Arjun + cc product manager (owner: Maya; timeline: today 2028-03-08 EOD).
2) Draft two promotion bullets (ownership, measurable impact) and share with Sami for iteration (owner: Maya & Sami; timeline: draft by 2028-03-10).
3) Short runbook (oncall handoff checklist) created and uploaded to Confluence with a single playbook page (owner: Sami; timeline: before PTO 2028-03-15).
4) Create follow-up ticket for flaky test and add a short reproducibility note; mark it as P1 for triage (owner: Sami; timeline: 2028-03-12).
5) Schedule postmortem facilitation slot with EngOps for incident on 2028-03-12 (owner: Maya; timeline: schedule today).

Follow-up cadence: quick async check on the three items in 48 hours (Maya will ping in Slack), full 1:1 follow-up slot on 2028-03-16 to review packet bullets and postmortem outcomes.

Open questions / prompts to ask in the 1:1:
- Which part of the rollout still feels risky to you? Where do you want my help to remove friction?
- Are there any signals we should surface to the promotions committee beyond latency metrics? (e.g., mentorship outcomes, cross-team influence)
- What would make the oncall runbook feel 'good enough' for an interim handoff?

Quick reminders for the manager (Maya):
- Keep the meeting micro-focused; default to action-driven outcomes rather than long status updates.
- Bring the promotion bullet template to the meeting (three lines: context, action, impact + metric).
- After the meeting: translate action items into JIRA tickets if owner asks, and move any follow-ups into shared calendar with reminders.

Tone notes: be direct, supportive, bias to unblock. Center the conversation on Sami's agency (what they want to own) while offering concrete managerial leverage (escalations, draft bullets, scheduling).

Quick log for record:
- Meeting length target: 20–25 min
- Key outcomes desired: escalation sent, runbook started, promotion bullets drafted

End of note.
